name: v3.4.2
body:
## What's Changed
* fix(kernel): fix time side-channel detection in selinux hide (https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/pull/3877) by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1601
* feat: support forcing feature values via ksu_config (incl. boot-patch-v2) (https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/pull/3878) by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1603
* feat: block kernel modules at boot via native module_blacklist (https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/pull/3881) by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1607
* scripts: ksunextbot: Accommodate nested backticks by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1608
* feat: add shell_su_adb_only feature to restrict shell root to adb sessions (https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/pull/3882) by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1609
* fix(manager): require explicit opt-in to block kernel modules (https://github.com/tiann/KernelSU/pull/3883) by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1610
* manager: improve the unrooted bugreport by @omrxm18 in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1602
* kernel: susfs (LKM): Implement a dead man's switch by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1611
* kernel: susfs (LKM): open_redirect: scheme 4; kstat, sus_path: stat/dirent post-checks from sys_call_table by @pershoot in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1616
* New Crowdin updates by @rifsxd in https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/pull/1612


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/KernelSU-Next/KernelSU-Next/compare/v3.4.1...v3.4.2
